pageProps.title: Prestigious Gasiri Restaurant
pageProps.review: Prestigious Gasiri Restaurant in Pyoseon-myeon, Seogwipo, Jeju, is a hidden gem for Mom-guk (seaweed soup) that I visit every time I'm in Jeju. It's a local spot with an excellent, rich broth.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Mom-guk", "rating": 5 } --- A true gem ``` ## Review A hidden gem in Jeju! It's a Mom-guk spot I visit every time I'm in Jeju. People say the Duruchigi (spicy stir-fried pork) is good too, but I haven't tried it yet. ## Pictures
